turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi there! I'll think out loud through one example first.
I have a pen. "Pen" starts with a "p" sound. That isn't a vowel sound, so the right word is a.
So here is the rule: we put an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
This is right: "She eats an apple." This is wrong: "I have an pen."

Now please try this one on your own:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
